cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, let's reconnect over dinner. Remember how I taught you to pace a difficult conversation? I'll leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've picked a topic. Put that before pudding; I taught you to finish on something pleasant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book your next lesson over another dinner. Don't try to cover everything at once. I want to keep seeing you, and I want to leave at ten.
